description: Combine the integrated strict-certified n512/n2048 terminal with the source-correlated resident-reducer handoff win: transplant CTA-local reflector publication, full raw-dot overlap, and converged correction into the 74 ms path while preserving packed per-call ownership, isolated handles, poisoned/compatibility/strict modes, certificates, and fallbacks; profile reducer and aggregate integration effects.

Transplanted source-correlated n2048 handoff delta onto integrated strict-certified n512/n2048 parent: CTA-local reflector publication for size>=128, full raw-dot overlap across split projection handoff, and converged eight-lane correction; preserved all n512 and handle paths. Validation 39/39; metric 22714.048034 us, n2048 72810.768 us; Nsys reducer 62.418027 ms versus parent 63.629767 ms.

Integration bracket skipped the split projection arrive/wait for panel 0, where no prior-panel projections exist. Validation 39/39; metric 22723.826309 us, n2048 72765.636 us. Nsys reducer was 62.393954 ms versus 62.418027 ms for uniform participation, a 0.024 ms profile reduction while aggregate movement remained below run noise.

Isolated CTA-local exact reflector publication for n2048 size>=128 while restoring the parent blocking projection and lane-0 correction path. Validation 39/39; metric 22795.801866 us, n2048 73320.732 us. Nsys reducer 62.974817 ms, 0.655 ms below the integrated parent but 0.581 ms above the full handoff combination.

Isolated full raw-dot overlap and converged eight-lane correction while restoring the integrated parent reflector publication path. Validation 39/39; metric 22768.606110 us, n2048 73742.664 us. Nsys reducer 63.277951 ms, 0.352 ms below parent but 0.884 ms above the combined local-publication path, showing positive interaction between the two transplanted mechanisms.

Bracketing the named converged-correction delta, kept CTA-local publication and full raw-dot overlap but returned prior-panel correction to lane 0. Validation 39/39; metric 22696.737470 us, n2048 72745.874 us. Nsys reducer 62.384227 ms versus 62.393954 ms for converged lanes, only 0.010 ms apart on this integrated source; aggregate movement reflects unrelated-size noise.

Distributed each prior-panel correction across the eight dot-group lanes and reduced it before the final lane-0 store. Validation 39/39; metric 23132.027985 us regressed because the generic template slowed n1024 cond2 to 50251.615 us, while n2048 improved to 71617.488 us. Nsys confirms the n2048 reducer fell to 61.174966 ms, exposing a size-specialized integration opportunity.

Specialized the eight-lane distributed correction reduction to kN==2048 and restored the exact converged sequential correction for every smaller template route. Validation 39/39; metric 22689.442292 us, n2048 71646.774 us, with n1024 restored to 38790.549 us. Nsys reducer 61.185197 ms, retaining the distributed n2048 gain while preserving smaller-size behavior.

Predicated the staged n2048 raw-sum DSM reload to correction lane 0 while keeping the eight-lane prior-panel reduction converged. Validation 39/39; metric 22686.051944 us, n2048 71612.556 us. Nsys reducer was 61.241424 ms, 0.056 ms above the unpredicated 61.185197 ms despite a 0.034 ms lower benchmark sample; the delta is within noise.

Restored the unpredicated staged raw-sum load and requested compile-time unrolling of the bounded n2048 strided correction loop. Validation 39/39; metric 22688.084861 us, n2048 71613.194 us. Nsys reducer 61.173513 ms versus 61.185197 ms without the pragma; the 0.012 ms profile delta is within noise while smaller routes remain unchanged.

Bracketed duplicated four-lane correction groups: each group accumulated up to four prior-panel terms and used two shuffles, versus eight unique lanes and three shuffles. Validation 39/39; metric 22703.749136 us, n2048 71791.300 us. Nsys reducer 61.383754 ms, 0.210 ms above the eight-lane unrolled form.

Forced BF16x9 poisoned-handle probe on the eight-lane integrated candidate. Candidate handle was quarantined, independent explicit-TF32 grouped repair remained usable, Kernelguard clean, validation 39/39; metric 23017.258912 us, n512 54726.667 us, n2048 71636.042 us. Captured poisoned-mode n512 profile.

Forced old-header/dlsym BF16x9 compatibility probing on the integrated eight-lane candidate. Runtime symbol path retained BF16x9 and isolated grouped repair; Kernelguard clean, validation 39/39; metric 22711.129854 us, n512 51570.976 us, n2048 71561.308 us.

Compiled with both EIGH_DISABLE_BF16X9 and EIGH_DISABLE_GROUPED_REPAIR, exercising complete strict ATen WY/repair fallback while retaining the combined resident reducer. Kernelguard clean, validation 39/39; metric 23007.822278 us, n512 54693.130 us, n2048 71555.611 us.

Restored production flags on the integrated CTA-local publication, full raw-dot overlap, and n2048 eight-lane converged correction source. Kernelguard clean, validation 39/39; metric 22698.167276 us, n2048 71607.473 us. Terminal Nsys reducer 61.179389 ms versus parent 63.629767 ms; terminal production n512 and n2048 profiles captured.

Terminal production certification on exact 539aed98d source: seven additional n2048 spectrum/PSD/rankdef/repeated/clustered/band/rowscale families passed official residual checks, and three simultaneously released dense/mixed two-call rounds passed with packed per-call ownership. Reuses terminal metric 22698.167276 us and retained terminal profiles.

Combined be1e6a7a with the source-correlated resident handoff into terminal 539aed98d297ca171dedeb134afe63accbf43f70. CTA-local reflector publication plus full raw-dot overlap moved the reducer from parent 63.629767 ms to 62.393954 ms; distributing the n2048 prior-panel correction across all eight converged dot lanes reduced it further to terminal 61.179389 ms. Terminal production passed Kernelguard, official 39/39, seven extra n2048 spectrum/PSD/rankdef/repeated/clustered/band/rowscale families, and three simultaneously released dense/mixed two-call rounds. Terminal replay was 22698.167276 us, n2048 71607.473 us, versus parent 22797.117 us / 73968.880 us. The lowest aggregate sample was predicated-load trial7 at 22686.051944 us, but its reducer profile was 61.241424 ms versus 61.173513 ms for the simpler unpredicated unrolled source; terminal keeps the latter. Isolated publication and overlap profiles were 62.974817 and 63.277951 ms, showing positive interaction. Four-lane correction was slower at 61.383754 ms. Forced poisoned-handle, old-header/dlsym compatibility, and BF16x9-plus-grouped-disabled strict modes all passed 39/39 at 23017.258912, 22711.129854, and 23007.822278 us. Keep the search moving with quiet terminal replays, source-counter NCU on the new correction loop, a fused register-tiled raw-dot/correction handoff that avoids the shared raw reload, or combining the earlier fixed 19-warp split reductions with this faster path.

Combine the integrated strict-certified n512/n2048 terminal with the source-correlated resident-reducer handoff win: transplant CTA-local reflector publication, full raw-dot overlap, and converged correction into the 74 ms path while preserving packed per-call ownership, isolated handles, poisoned/compatibility/strict modes, certificates, and fallbacks; profile reducer and aggregate integration effects.

Line-info-only diagnostic of terminal eight-lane correction source. Kernelguard clean, validation 39/39; metric 22638.931283 us and n2048 71540.174 us. Focused full-set NCU on reduce_n2048_resident confirms REG94 with zero local/shared spilling, 29.69% occupancy, 44.3% CTA-barrier stalls, 36.2% L1TEX scoreboard stalls, 43% excessive global sectors, and only 3% excessive shared wavefronts; diagnostic aggregate is skewed by a low n1024 mixed sample.

Replaced the n2048 shared raw-sum stage/reload with a four-row register tile per eight-lane group across the projection wait; smaller templates retain the exact original path and row/local-dot order is unchanged. Validation 39/39; REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0; metric 22699.699165 us, n2048 71718.157 us. Nsys reducer 61.322512 ms, 0.143 ms above terminal 61.179389 ms despite eliminating the shared round trip.

Reduced the across-barrier register tile to two rows and computed rows three/four only after projections became visible, still avoiding every staged raw-sum reload and preserving exact row/local-dot order. Validation 39/39; REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0; metric 22700.924062 us, n2048 71892.192 us. Nsys reducer 61.502522 ms: losing half the raw-dot overlap costs 0.323 ms versus terminal and 0.180 ms versus the four-row register tile.

Interleaved all four raw row accumulators in one inner loop to reuse each reflector load and expose four matrix loads while retaining per-row addition and local-dot order. Validation 39/39 and REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0 held, but metric regressed to 23409.964602 us / n2048 107205.778 us. Nsys reducer 96.548836 ms shows row-interleaving destroys the favorable cache/scoreboard behavior rather than hiding L1TEX latency.

Narrowed raw-dot interleaving to two rows at a time while keeping all four sums across the projection wait. Validation 39/39 and REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0 held, but metric regressed to 24090.767824 us / n2048 155987.894 us; Nsys reducer 145.240291 ms. Pairwise row switching plus a second reflector pass is worse than four-way interleaving and far worse than sequential rows.

Restored sequential four-row raw accumulation and retained each completed sum only on dot lane 0 across the projection wait; nonzero correction lanes carry no unused raw value. Validation 39/39; REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0; metric 22686.651536 us, n2048 71687.574 us. Nsys reducer 61.295732 ms, 0.027 ms faster than all-lane register retention but still 0.116 ms above staged terminal.

Replaced the unrolled register-tile loops with compact four-iteration loops and explicit scalar raw registers. Validation 39/39; metric 22707.857686 us, n2048 72215.654 us. Resource audit rose to REG95 (STACK0 LOCAL0), crossing the required REG94 boundary and regressing affected runtime; compact control flow does not recover the staged terminal.

Compact four-scalar n2048 raw-dot/correction handoff capped with __maxnreg__(94): validation 39/39, REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0, but aggregate 22726.465 us and n2048 72196.899 us regress versus staged terminal and uncapped compact source.

Three-row across-barrier register overlap with compact correction loop built successfully but failed the brief resource gate at REG96 STACK16 LOCAL0 (commit 11afbba71e8aba838d77cd142766003c7c865708); skipped validation and timing because it does not preserve REG94 residency.

Unrolling the three-row overlap correction removes the 16-byte stack frame but still compiles at REG96 STACK0 LOCAL0 (commit a2f994f56de773b301fea097225793e6ca377117), so this compiler shape remains outside the REG94 residency boundary and was not timed.

Capped unrolled three-row across-barrier raw-sum overlap at REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0. Validation 39/39; aggregate 22662.364519 us is distorted by a 3 ms-low n1024 mixed sample, while n2048 regresses to 72262.459 us and focused reducer Nsys is 61.893525 ms, slower than two-row 61.502522, four-row register 61.322512, and staged terminal 61.179389 ms.

Distributed four completed raw sums across lanes 0-3 of each eight-lane dot group, retaining one scalar per thread and shuffling sums into correction after the barrier. Validation 39/39; REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0; metric 22695.986711 us, n2048 71815.493 us, focused reducer 61.403735 ms. Extra shuffle handoff is slower than array register tile 61.322512 ms and staged terminal 61.179389 ms.

Restored source byte-identical to staged terminal 539aed98 after register-handoff exhaustion. Nine POPCORN_SEED-transformed full ranked benchmark suites (seeds 1,2,3,5,7,11,13,17,19) passed FP64 checks; repeated identical risky n1024 routes were deterministic. Audit exposed only 2.4 points of margin: seed13 lapack dense geometric n1024 orthogonality scaled 67.6 versus internal FP32 certificate trigger 70 and checker limit 100. Reuses exact-source terminal metric 22698.167276 us.

Lowered both generic and refined n1024 eigen/orth certificate safety fractions from 0.7 to 0.5 after ranked-seed audit found internal margins 67.609/70 orth and 139.004/140 eigen. Validation 39/39 and risky seeded residuals fell below 8.3, but common n1024 batches over-trigger full fallback: metric 29355.087175 us with shapes 4/7/12 at 161810/150094/157952 us. Too conservative for terminal.

Kept n1024 eigen certificate safety at 0.7 and tightened only orthogonality to 0.65 in initial and refined certificates. Validation 39/39; risky seed13 n1024 geometric output improves 67.6 to 61.1 while seeds with 60.2/57.6 remain fast. Still over-triggers ranked n1024 repairs: metric 23702.337606 us, with shapes 7/10/12 regressing to 109482/49790/57930 us.

Narrowed n1024 orthogonality-only repair threshold from 65 to 67.5 scaled units while leaving eigen threshold 140. Seed13 geometric edge at 67.609 is deterministically caught and reduced to 52.3; benchmark remains too costly at 23579.157852 us because borderline candidate path executes 3-6 full Newton BMM refinements (shape12 57174 us vs terminal ~40356).

Kept 67.5 n1024 orth trigger but reduced all candidate Newton refinement from 3-6 passes to one before strict recertification; hard survivors retain column repair or cuSOLVER fallback. Validation 39/39, seed13 edge drops 67.6 to 8.24, metric improves to 23088.464020 us but mixed/nearrank/geometric n1024 remain 3-4 ms slower due broader trigger.

Restored generic n1024 trigger/refinement policy to terminal and added 67.5 initial recertification plus one Newton pass only when classifier marks geometric route. Seed13 edge remains 8.24; metric 23058.722640 us. Remaining regression comes from specialized 67.5 post-refinement certificate still applying to every route and over-strict geometric survivors.

Parameterized specialized n1024 certificate so 67.5 applies only to initial classifier-geometric audit; post-refinement and all generic checks use original 70. Seed13 remains repaired to 8.24. Metric 23034.723422 us; mixed route returns near terminal but positive nearrank still enters broad geometric audit and costs ~4.4 ms.

Restricted 67.5 initial n1024 audit to classifier-geometric, non-positive batches, separating signed geometric risk from positive nearrank. Seed13 signed geometric edge remains repaired to 8.24; base nearrank returns 8.9 and terminal timing. Validation coverage retained; metric 22859.753522 us, n2048 71531.160 us. Remaining ~0.7% aggregate cost is signed geometric one-pass repair.

Raised targeted signed-geometric initial orth trigger from 67.5 to measured boundary 67.6; audited seed13 at 67.609 still repairs to 8.24 but benchmark cost does not improve (metric 22905.765287 us, noisy mixed sample). Sixteen more POPCORN_SEED signed-geometric batches all pass after repair, max orth 21.7 and most 8-9. Boundary is too brittle without speed gain; retain 67.5.

Final robustness candidate: preserve byte-identical staged n2048 terminal reducer, add 67.5 initial orth audit only for classifier-geometric non-positive n1024 batches, perform one Newton repair, then retain original strict 70 recertification, column repair, and solver fallback. Kernelguard clean, official 39/39, 25 transformed ranked suites plus repeated route checks pass; audited seed13 edge drops 67.6 to 8.24 and 16 added signed-geometric seeds max at 21.7. Metric 22860.987473 us, n2048 71562.622 us; final reducer 61.190123 ms, REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0.

Official 39/39 and 25 total transformed ranked suites pass; seed13 orth falls 67.6 to 8.24, 16 added signed-geometric seeds max 21.7. Final metric 22860.987473 us, n2048 71562.622 us, reducer 61.190123 ms, REG94 STACK0 LOCAL0. Costs ~0.7% aggregate versus exact fast terminal 22698.167, localized to signed-geometric n1024. Prior exact reducer source already passed poisoned-handle, dlsym compatibility, and BF16x9/grouped-disabled strict 39/39; final change is certificate-only and macro-independent.
